falsification: A publisher or equivalent current-game row replacement after setup and before the first village read falsifies the simple unreplaced-row hypothesis for that run; it does not prove freshness of all numerator/cache inputs. Donor-specific retained rows plus their actual normal selector consumption would confirm that state lifetime; different priority or RNG alternatives require another explanation.
conclusion: Selected reset fills bracket the metric table; selected load publication precedes recount and can read saved statistics. Indirect/setup effects and ordered runtime retention are unresolved. The retail inter-session report is not reproduced or fixed.
